purpose: Central registry of book-catalog sources spanning the prophetic era, early generations, historical eras, modern works, and future additions. This registry governs discovery/census only; rights and PDF acquisition remain separate gates.

eras.label: Prophet era
eras.note: Prophetic-life/event source works; historical scope is topic-oriented and must not be mistaken for author death chronology.

eras.label: Companions and Followers
eras.note: Mixed source catalogs are retained; precise generation/era classification is accepted only when explicit evidence exists.

eras.label: 1-400H
eras.note: Chronological early-source acquisition catalog; author death year is preferred for ordering.

eras.label: 401-800H
eras.note: Open for all current and future catalog batches covering this era.

eras.label: 801-1200H
eras.note: Open for all current and future catalog batches covering this era.

eras.label: 1201H onward
eras.note: Modern-era records remain in discovery until edition and rights are verified.

eras.label: Modern era
eras.note: Modern books are included for census and source matching; publication rights remain edition-specific.

eras.label: Future books
eras.note: Additive and permanent: any newly saved governed catalog/source becomes eligible for the next census without redesigning the engine.

dorar.role: supplementary discovery and bibliographic matching only
dorar.rights: never inferred from Dorar index presence
dorar.pdf: never downloaded from the Dorar index endpoint
